title: Heart diseases
description: Tech: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Random Forest, Flask, React, Tailwind CSS, Git  Built a machine learning model to predict heart disease risk from clinical patient data, achieving over 85% classification accuracy.  Implemented and compared Random Forest and XGBoost algorithms; selected the best-performing model after cross- validation.  Handled end-to-end data pipeline including preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation using Scikit-learn.  Developed a React-based frontend for data input and result visualization, connected to a Flask REST API backend.

title: Trust-bridge
description: Tech: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Hashgraph  Designed and developed a full-stack web platform connecting verified NGOs with donors, reducing friction in the donation process.  Integrated NGO verification workflow so donors can review campaigns, funding goals, and credentials before donating.  Built secure transaction flows using Hashgraph, ensuring donation records are tamper-proof and auditable.  Implemented responsive UI with React and Tailwind CSS, ensuring smooth experience across desktop and mobile devices.
